items.title: Welcome to the notice board
items.title_ti: ናብ ሰሌዳ ማስታወቂያ እንቋዕ ብደሓን መጻእኩም
items.text: Short announcements and updates from the Eparchy appear here. Add, pin or remove them on the Admin page → Announcements.
items.text_ti: ሓጸርቲ ማስታወቂያታትን ሓደሽቲ ሓበሬታታትን ካብ ኤጳርቅና ኣብዚ ይቐርቡ። ኣብ ገጽ ምምሕዳር (Admin) → Announcements ወስኹ፡ ኣብ ላዕሊ ኣቐምጡ ወይ ኣልግሱ።

items.title: The liturgical calendar is now on the website
items.title_ti: ሊጡርጊያዊ ዓውደ-ኣዋርሕ ሕጂ ኣብ መርበብ ሓበሬታ ኣሎ
items.text: Today’s feast, the coming feasts and fasts, the Sundays of the year and a date converter.
items.text_ti: በዓል ናይ ሎሚ፡ ዝመጽኡ በዓላትን ኣጽዋማትን፡ ሰናብቲ ናይ ዓመትን መቐየሪ ዕለትን።

items.title: Example: an event
items.text: Give the day of the event as its date: the leaf shows it in Ge’ez and in the Gregorian calendar. With a “Hide after” date it leaves the board by itself.
items.text_ti: መዓልቲ ናይቲ ፍጻመ ከም ዕለት ሃቡ፦ እታ ቅጽላ ብግእዝን ብጎርጎርዮሳዊ ዓውደ-ኣዋርሕን ተርእዮ። ዕለት “Hide after” እንተሃብኩምዎ ባዕሉ ካብ ሰሌዳ ይወጽእ።

items.title: Example: an urgent notice
items.text: Urgent notices are marked in red, for a change of time, a closed office or a call for prayer.
items.text_ti: ህጹጻት ምልክታታት ብቀይሕ ይፍለጡ፦ ንለውጢ ሰዓት፡ ንዕጹው ቤት ጽሕፈት ወይ ንጻውዒት ጸሎት።

items.title: Example: an announcement
items.text: For office hours, collections, appointments and other short news without photos. News with photos goes under News & Articles.
items.text_ti: ንሰዓታት ቤት ጽሕፈት፡ ንእከባታት፡ ንሹመታትን ካልኦት ሓጸርቲ ዜናታት ብዘይ ስእልን። ስእሊ ዘለዎ ዜና ኣብ News & Articles ይኣቱ።
